home.groupSkinText: Diagnosis and treatment of common skin conditions, marks and growths.
home.groupHairText: Finding the likely cause of hair fall before recommending treatment.
home.groupCosmeticText: Laser, anti-ageing and nail treatments, after a medical assessment.
home.treatmentsTitle: Care for common skin and hair concerns
home.treatmentsText: Every treatment starts with a consultation, so your plan is based on an assessment of your skin or scalp.
home.expectTitle: What to expect at the clinic
home.expect1Text: MBBS (Osmania), MD DVL (Gandhi), and Assistant Professor at Gandhi Medical College, Secunderabad.
home.expect2Text: Your skin, hair, scalp or nails are examined first, and the options suited to you are explained.
home.expect3Text: Chemical peels, PRP therapy, radiofrequency ablation, intralesional injections and skin or scalp biopsy, where suitable.
home.expect4Text: Monday to Saturday, 10 AM – 10 PM. Sunday by prior appointment.
home.step1Text: Choose a concern and a preferred date and time online, or call the clinic.

about.metaTitle: About the Clinic | Derma World Skin & Hair Clinic, Moula Ali
about.metaDescription: Derma World Skin & Hair Clinic in Moula Ali, near ECIL: dermatology, cosmetology, hair and laser care with Dr. Sathaiah Sudhamalla, MBBS (Osmania), MD DVL (Gandhi).
about.title: About Derma World Skin & Hair Clinic
about.intro: A dermatology clinic in Moula Ali, Hyderabad, near ECIL, offering dermatology, cosmetology, hair and laser care under Dr. Sathaiah Sudhamalla.
about.approach1: Every visit begins with a consultation. The doctor listens to your concern, examines your skin, hair, scalp or nails, and explains the options suited to you.
about.approach2: The clinic manages skin, hair and nail disorders — including acne and acne scars, pigmentation, hair fall, skin allergies, fungal infections, and warts and skin tags — and offers PRP, chemical peels, laser and anti-ageing treatments where they are suitable.
about.approach3: There is an in-clinic pharmacy at reception.
about.servicesNote: As listed at the clinic. The doctor will advise which, if any, is right for you.
about.care1Text: The doctor explains your condition and the options in plain language, so you can make an informed decision.
about.care2Text: Your plan is based on your assessment — not a one-size-fits-all package.
about.care3Text: Results vary from person to person. The doctor will discuss what is realistic for you before you begin.
